title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 9: weeping for the slain, deceitful tongues, mourning women called, and the right thing to glory in.

questions.text: Why does the speaker wish his head were waters and his eyes a spring of tears?
questions.explanation: He wishes it so that he might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people.

answers.text: To wash away the many sins of his rebellious people
To water the dry and thirsty land in the drought
To weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people
To quench the fire of Yahweh's burning anger against Judah

questions.text: What does the speaker wish he had in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: He wishes he had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men, so that he might leave his people and go from them, for they are all adulterers.

answers.text: A lodging place of wayfaring men
A spring of fresh flowing water
A high and fortified tower
A great flock of sheep and goats

questions.text: Like what do the people bend their tongue for falsehood?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood," and they have grown strong in the land, but not for truth.

answers.text: Like a sickle
Like a snare
Like a whip
Like their bow

questions.text: What is the people's tongue called in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Their tongue is a deadly arrow that speaks deceit: one speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in his heart he waits to ambush him.

answers.text: A burning fire
A deadly arrow
A sharp sword
A poisoned well

questions.text: What does Yahweh say He will make Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "I will make Jerusalem heaps, a dwelling place of jackals," and the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.

answers.text: Heaps, a dwelling place of jackals
A light to all the nations of the earth
A den of young roaring lions
A field of thorns and briers

questions.text: What does Yahweh of Armies say He will feed this people and give them to drink?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says He will feed this people with wormwood and give them poisoned water to drink.

answers.text: Bread of tears and wine of sorrow
Manna and water from the rock
Ashes and vinegar
Wormwood and poisoned water

questions.text: Who does Yahweh of Armies say should be called and sent for to take up a wailing?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says to call for the mourning women and send for the skillful women, that they may make haste and take up a wailing.

answers.text: The elders of all the cities of Judah
The mourning women and the skillful women
The priests and the prophets of the land
The singers of the temple of Yahweh

questions.text: Through what has death come up, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Death has come up into our windows and entered into our palaces, to cut off the children from outside and the young men from the streets.

answers.text: The city gates
The broken walls
Our windows
The wells of water

questions.text: In what should the one who glories glory, instead of wisdom, might or riches?
questions.explanation: Let him who glories glory in this: that he has understanding and knows Yahweh, who exercises loving kindness, justice, and righteousness in the earth.

answers.text: In the law and the covenant
In having understanding and knowing Yahweh
In the glory of Jerusalem
In the deeds of his fathers

questions.text: What does the last verse of this chapter say about all the house of Israel?
questions.explanation: The chapter ends saying that all the nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in heart.

answers.text: They are uncircumcised in heart
They will return from exile
They are scattered beyond the river
They have forgotten the Sabbath
